title: Google\Cloud\Bigtable\V2\RowFilter\Condition
name: Condition
description: A RowFilter which evaluates one of two possible RowFilters, depending on whether or not a predicate RowFilter outputs any cells from the input row.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.predicate_filter
params.description: If predicate_filter outputs any cells, then true_filter will be evaluated on the input row. Otherwise, false_filter will be evaluated.

params.name: data.true_filter
params.description: The filter to apply to the input row if predicate_filter returns any results. If not provided, no results will be returned in the true case.

params.name: data.false_filter
params.description: The filter to apply to the input row if predicate_filter does not return any results. If not provided, no results will be returned in the false case.

methods.name: getPredicateFilter
methods.description: If predicate_filter outputs any cells, then true_filter will be evaluated on the input row. Otherwise, false_filter will be evaluated.

methods.name: setPredicateFilter
methods.description: If predicate_filter outputs any cells, then true_filter will be evaluated on the input row. Otherwise, false_filter will be evaluated.

methods.name: getTrueFilter
methods.description: The filter to apply to the input row if predicate_filter returns any results. If not provided, no results will be returned in the true case.

methods.name: setTrueFilter
methods.description: The filter to apply to the input row if predicate_filter returns any results. If not provided, no results will be returned in the true case.

methods.name: getFalseFilter
methods.description: The filter to apply to the input row if predicate_filter does not return any results. If not provided, no results will be returned in the false case.

methods.name: setFalseFilter
methods.description: The filter to apply to the input row if predicate_filter does not return any results. If not provided, no results will be returned in the false case.
